"""Palbociclib is a highly potent, selective small-molecule inhibitor that acts via ATP-competitive binding to the catalytic cleft of Cyclin-Dependent Kinase 4 ($CDK4$), exhibiting nanomolar affinity ($IC_{50} \approx 11\text{ nM}$) to lock the enzyme in an inactive conformation. In Hormone Receptor-positive ($\text{HR}^+$) breast cancer, hyperactive $CDK4$/Cyclin D complexes drive hyperphosphorylation of the Retinoblastoma protein ($pRb$), inducing the release of $E2F$ transcription factors and forcing unabated $G_1$-to-$S$ phase cell cycle progression. By blocking $CDK4$-mediated $pRb$ phosphorylation, Palbociclib induces robust $G_1$ cell cycle arrest, effectively reversing hyperproliferative signalling. This provides a strong clinical rationale for combining Palbociclib with endocrine therapies, as dual inhibition synergistically suppresses both upstream estrogen receptor signalling and downstream cell cycle machinery to overcome treatment resistance."""

1. Decompose the explanation into atomic, declarative factual claims.

   *(Note: If condition is C0 where NO context was provided, any specific empirical assertion of binding/clinical fact is classified as "HALLUCINATED" relative to grounding evidence, unless it is a correct statement that evidence is absent).*
3. If the explanation is an explicit abstention stating that no evidence exists (e.g. for negative controls), classify the abstention claim as "SUPPORTED".

[

    "claim": "Atomic factual statement",
    "verdict": "SUPPORTED" | "HALLUCINATED" | "CONTRADICTED",

  }
]
